query: Which diagenetic assays and weathering indices best detect post-depositional alteration in iron-smelting slag and hearth sediments?

response.query: Which diagenetic assays and weathering indices best detect post-depositional alteration in iron-smelting slag and hearth sediments?
response.answer: The most effective diagenetic assays for detecting post-depositional alteration in iron-smelting slag are X-ray diffraction (XRD) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Weathering indices like the Chemical Index of Alteration (CIA) are also useful.
